cues.text: Long ago, in a fishing village by the sea,
there lived a kind young fisherman, Urashima Tarō.
One day he found children poking a turtle on the sand.
'Stop that,' he said, and sent them home.
Then he let the turtle go back into the sea.
Days later, the turtle rose beside his boat.
'Come with me,' it said, 'to the Dragon Palace.'
Down they went, through the light and the bubbles.
Princess Otohime welcomed him to the palace.
There were feasts, music and dancing fish.
The days passed by like a dream.
But Tarō missed his home and his mother.
The princess gave him a jewelled box.
'Never open it,' she said.
Back on the shore, nothing was as he had left it.
No one knew him. His house was gone.
Three hundred years had passed.
In his sorrow, Tarō untied the cord.
White smoke poured out of the box,
and he was an old, old man.
He sat by the sea he loved, watching the waves.
